trial_pages.title: ANVS-26001 (Buntanetap extension)
trial_pages.description: A 24-month Phase 2/3 safety extension study of buntanetap in Alzheimer's patients who participated in a prior trial.
trial_pages.drug: buntanetap (translational inhibitor of APP, Tau, and alpha-synuclein)
trial_pages.population: Alzheimer's Dementia patients who participated in a prior buntanetap clinical trial
trial_pages.why_md: Evaluates the long-term (24-month) safety of buntanetap. This addresses a major limitation of the prior [12-week Phase 2/3 study](/trials/buntanetap-nct05686044), which was widely considered too short to establish long-term disease modification.
